title: Canonical coordinate-face base data and derived exchange mates
statement: Let $R$ be a commutative ring, $r\in\mathbf N$, $t:\{1,\ldots,r\}\to R$, and $p\in\mathbf N$. Write $A_{p,t}$ for the compatible prime-to-$p$ root algebra, with all its power and divisibility relations [def-sfb-strict-local-kummer-tame-module]. For $J\subseteq\{1,\ldots,r\}$ define the base-face ideal $I_J=(t_j\mid j\in J)$ and its closed inclusion $g_J:\operatorname{Spec}(R/I_J)\to\operatorname{Spec}R$ by the quotient map. For a profinite set $P$ define $q_P:\operatorname{Spec}(A_{p,t})[P]\to\operatorname{Spec}R$ as the test projection followed by the spectrum of $R\to A_{p,t}$. Fix a commutative condensed ring $\Lambda$ and use the actual tests, internal modules over its pulled-back coefficients, exact pullbacks, ordinary unbounded derived direct images, adjunctions and normalized pullback compositions of [def-sfb-test-map-derived-composition]. For a module $N$ over these coefficients on any scheme $X$, its test complex is the degree-zero complex $(\pi_{X,P}^*N)[0]$ on $X[P]$. Given any commuting square $e:X'\to X$, $q':X'\to Y'$, $q:X\to Y$, $g:Y'\to Y$ with $qe=gq'$, define the pullback comparison $q'^*g^*\cong e^*q^*$ by the composite $q'^*g^*\cong(gq')^*=(qe)^*\cong e^*q^*$, with the usual right-to-left mathematical notation for application. Define the exchange $g^*Rq_*\to Rq'_*e^*$ as the mate of this comparison under the actual $q^*\dashv Rq_*$ and $q'^*\dashv Rq'_*$ adjunctions. In particular its transpose is the pullback comparison followed by $e^*$ of the $q$-counit. These are constructions for arbitrary commuting squares; cartesianness, invertibility of exchange and lisse hypotheses are not part of the definition.
